description: ACT-THREAD OWNER-BUSY approximation and OR-REENTRY: a recording sink on ConnectionEvents; on a new MTA thread Connection.Execute(a 3-way cross join count, Options 17 = adCmdText | adAsyncExecute) returns, the state is read, the thread then waits 2 s (no pump on the STA) and reads the state and Errors again, then Close. Asks which thread the ExecuteComplete callback runs on, whether it arrives at all while the owner thread is not pumping, and what the connection state is meanwhile.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-wire probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
